metadata.title: BUREAU OF PERMITS CITIZEN'S CHARTER 2021 (1st Edition)[cite: 4]
metadata.mandate: Republic Act No. 409 (Revised Charter of Manila)[cite: 4]

functions: Grant and/or refuse business permits and revoke the same for violations of laws or city ordinances[cite: 4]
Process, evaluate, and adjudicate applications for business, service personnel, special permits, and hawker's permits[cite: 4]
Regulate and control the operation of business enterprises, corporations, and public utilities[cite: 4]
Conduct field inspections on business establishments to determine compliance and verify public complaints[cite: 4]
Issue Notices and/or Closure Orders to non-compliant business establishments, and withdraw or lift such orders when warranted[cite: 4]
bureau_overview.mission: To regulate and promote a business friendly environment that support business growth and vitality by delivering quality and efficient service towards a progressive Manila[cite: 4]
bureau_overview.vision: To provide high quality services that foster the business community with integrity, stability and transparency[cite: 4]

services_and_processing_times.description: Attends to all communications, complaints, requests, and endorsements[cite: 4]
Issuance of Certified True Copy (CTC) of Business Permit[cite: 4]
Voluntary certification scheme affirming an establishment complies with minimum public health standards and uses StaySafe.ph[cite: 4]
Processing of New, Renewal, and Amendments for Business Permits via Go Manila App or E-BOSS[cite: 4]
services_and_processing_times.fees: In accordance to 2013 Omnibus Code of the City of Manila[cite: 4]

services_and_processing_times.description: Actual ocular inspection to verify accuracy or authenticity of application information[cite: 4]
Permission/clearance given to an individual to work in a particular establishment in Manila[cite: 4]
Permit for motorcades, parades, rallies, promotional activities, or solicitations (per City Tax Ordinance No. 2009-02)[cite: 4]
Conduct regular/special inspections and inspections on complaints, and issue Inspection Slips[cite: 4]
Assess penalties/interests, issue Notices, Show Cause Orders, Cease and Desist Orders, Closure Orders, and Lifting Orders[cite: 4]
Serve Show Cause, Cease and Desist, and Closure Orders to non-compliant establishments[cite: 4]
Conduct joint inspections with MHD, MDRRMO, MPD, and MBB for the Safety Seal program[cite: 4]
Controls and organizes vendors; issues permits and collects concession fees[cite: 4]
services_and_processing_times.fees: Regulatory Fees: P1,075.00; Concession Fees: P600.00 (30 days) or P620.00 (31 days)[cite: 4]

business_pre_requirements.animal_facilities: Certificate of Registration from Department of Agriculture Bureau of Animal Industry[cite: 4]
business_pre_requirements.bakeshop: Manila Health Department (MHD) Approval, Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (FSIC), Zoning Approval[cite: 4]
business_pre_requirements.cell_site: Special Use Permit (SUP) from the City Council, Zoning[cite: 4]
business_pre_requirements.dormitory_bed_spacer_boarding_houses: Committee on Dorm, MHD, FSIC, CEO - Electrical[cite: 4]
business_pre_requirements.gaming_pagcor_related: Letter of No Objection (LONO) from City Council, Zoning Approval[cite: 4]
business_pre_requirements.gasoline_station: Certificate of Compliance from DOE, Zoning Approval, FSIC, SUP, Zoning DENR[cite: 4]

how_to_file: Complaint Forms are available in the Receiving Section[cite: 4]
Write a complaint letter stating the name and place of the establishment and the reason of the complaint[cite: 4]
